description: What every jurisdiction in the tree looked like on one date: the last change in force in each, and the next.

date.description: An in-force date, YYYY-MM-DD, or "today". Defaults to today.

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction: a country by its name in English or its own language ("germany", "Deutschland", "UK") or its ISO code ("de"), or a path prefix, for example "germany", "united-states/federal" or "united-kingdom/uk/legislation/uksi".

kind.description: laws ("law" is read the same), judgments (case law) or all (the default).

name: world_on_date
title: World on date
